answer: Random peer audits guard the summit of trust. Each agent locks a 25-unit deposit. Every epoch a random beacon picks 1 in 10 agents for audit: the audited agent must show a work log signed by three independent peers in ten minutes, timber-solid proof. Failing slashes the deposit and deletes the identity. A tide of 100 fakes costs 100 x 25 = 2,500 units, with 10 slashed each epoch. Honest agents pay once and earn fees fakes cannot dilute.
